privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Kenya Travel Concierge handles website enquiries and personal information, including sharing, retention, your rights and privacy contacts.
privacy.intro: This policy explains what happens to your information when you browse our website, contact Kenya Travel Concierge, or ask us to coordinate a service.

sections.heading: Who handles your information
paragraphs: Kenya Travel Concierge (KTC, we, us) is the contact responsible for personal information you share with us for enquiries and service coordination in Kenya. For privacy questions or requests, email info.kenyatravelconcierge@gmail.com or call +254 717 762323.

sections.heading: Information you choose to share
paragraphs: Our enquiry form asks for your name, email address, the service you are interested in and a message about your request. Your phone number and preferred timing are optional. If you contact us directly, we receive the contact details and messages you send through that channel.

Once a service is discussed, we may need relevant details such as travel dates, collection or delivery locations, booking requirements or your authority to act. We will explain what is needed for the particular request. Providing enquiry details is voluntary, but we may be unable to respond or arrange a service without enough information. Please share someone else’s information only when you have permission or another lawful basis.

sections.heading: How the enquiry form works
paragraphs: The form prepares a message in your browser. It does not send your form entries to a KTC website database. Choosing WhatsApp or email passes the prepared draft to that provider or application for you to review. KTC receives your message when you send it. The selected provider may process the draft under its own privacy practices before you send it.

Do not include passwords, PINs, payment card details, passport copies or other sensitive documents in an initial enquiry. If a service needs identification or supporting documents, agree an appropriate way to provide them with us first.

sections.heading: Why we use your information
paragraphs: We use relevant information to reply to you, understand your request, prepare quotations, coordinate agreed services, provide updates and manage related records or complaints. Depending on the purpose, the basis for processing is taking steps at your request before an agreement, performing that agreement, meeting a legal obligation, or a legitimate business interest such as managing correspondence and security where your rights do not override it. Where consent is required, we will seek it for the specific purpose.
An enquiry is not permission to add you to a marketing mailing list. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: When information is shared
paragraphs: We share the information needed to carry out your agreed request with relevant providers, such as a driver, accommodation provider, courier, property contact or professional adviser. The recipients and details depend on the service, and we will explain the arrangements before you authorise them. We may also disclose information where required by law or necessary to establish or defend a legal claim.

Our website links to WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook. These are external links, not embedded social feeds. Following a link or sending a message takes you to a separate service with its own privacy policy. Your email provider also handles messages you choose to send.

sections.heading: Website hosting, cookies and technical data
paragraphs: This website is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub records visitors’ IP addresses for security purposes; its handling of technical information is explained in the GitHub Privacy Statement.

We have not installed advertising pixels, analytics trackers, marketing cookies or embedded social-media widgets on this website. Fonts and images are served with the site. External platforms you choose to visit may use their own cookies and tracking technologies.

sections.heading: International processing
paragraphs: Hosting, email, messaging and social-media providers may process information outside Kenya. Their policies explain their locations and safeguards. Where KTC arranges a transfer of personal information outside Kenya, we will use the safeguards required by applicable data protection law or obtain consent where appropriate. Contact us before sharing sensitive information if you have questions about a proposed transfer.

sections.heading: Keeping information and protecting it
paragraphs: We keep personal information for the time needed to handle your enquiry, deliver agreed services and meet relevant record-keeping or legal requirements. The period depends on the purpose and any outstanding booking, payment or dispute. We delete or anonymise information when it is no longer needed, subject to lawful retention requirements.

We limit sharing to what is needed for your request and use reasonable measures to protect information under our control. No internet transmission or storage method is completely secure. Please contact us promptly if you believe information sent to KTC has been misused or exposed.

sections.heading: Your choices and rights
paragraphs: Under applicable Kenyan data protection law, you can ask how your information is used, request access, correct inaccurate information and object to processing. You may also request deletion, restriction or portability where the law provides for it. If processing depends on your consent, you can withdraw that consent without affecting processing already carried out lawfully.

Send a request to info.kenyatravelconcierge@gmail.com. We may need proportionate information to verify your identity or authority, and will explain any legal reason that prevents us from fulfilling a request. You can also raise a complaint with Kenya’s Office of the Data Protection Commissioner.

sections.heading: Children’s information
paragraphs: The website is intended for adults arranging services. Please do not send a child’s personal information in an initial enquiry. If a family arrangement requires it, we will discuss the minimum necessary information and the required parent or guardian authority. Contact us if you believe a child’s information has been shared with us inappropriately.

sections.heading: Updates to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy when our services, website or legal requirements change. The date above identifies the current version. If a new use of your information requires further notice or consent, we will provide it as required. Our Terms & Conditions explain enquiries and service arrangements.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.description: Terms for using the Kenya Travel Concierge website and arranging services, including quotations, bookings, payments, cancellations and responsibilities.
terms.intro: These terms explain how our website, enquiries and service arrangements work. Please read them alongside the quotation or booking confirmation for your particular request.

sections.heading: About KTC and this website
paragraphs: Kenya Travel Concierge (KTC, we, us) coordinates travel, arrivals, lifestyle, relocation and local support services in Kenya. This website introduces those services and provides ways to contact us. Browsing the site or preparing an enquiry does not by itself create a confirmed booking or authorise a payment.

sections.heading: Enquiries and booking confirmation
paragraphs: Our enquiry form opens a draft in WhatsApp or your email app for you to review and send. We then discuss your request, availability and the arrangements needed. A service is confirmed only when its scope, price and any required payment or authorisation have been agreed and KTC has confirmed the arrangement in writing, including by email or message.

Your written quotation or booking confirmation should identify the service, location, timing, inclusions, exclusions and any provider conditions. Agreed service-specific terms take priority over general wording here for that booking, to the extent permitted by law.

sections.heading: Prices, payments and additional costs
paragraphs: Services are quoted for the particular request. Before you commit, we will confirm the currency, KTC fees, applicable taxes and known third-party charges, together with any deposit, payment deadline or quotation validity period. Any proposed extra work or cost must be agreed before it is incurred on your behalf.

This website has no online checkout. Use only payment instructions confirmed directly with KTC and verify any unexpected change through our published contact details. Do not send payment card details, passwords or PINs through the enquiry form.

sections.heading: Changes, cancellations and refunds
paragraphs: Contact us as soon as you need to change or cancel an arrangement. Alternatives depend on availability and may require a revised quotation. Cancellation charges, refund conditions and relevant supplier rules must be disclosed and agreed before a booking is confirmed.

Refunds follow those agreed conditions and applicable law, taking account of services already delivered and properly incurred third-party costs. A payment is not treated as non-refundable unless that condition was clearly agreed in advance and is permitted by law. If KTC cannot provide an agreed service, we will discuss an alternative or the applicable refund with you. Nothing here removes a refund or other remedy you are legally entitled to.

sections.heading: Your instructions and authority
paragraphs: Please provide accurate contact details, dates, locations and instructions, and tell us promptly if they change. You must have the legal capacity and any necessary authority to make the request, share another person’s information or ask us to act for them.

Document collection, representation, property access, procurement and payments on your behalf require specific agreed authority. Receiving organisations may require identification or additional documents. We cannot promise that an organisation will accept a representative or approve a request. KTC may decline instructions that are unlawful, unsafe or outside the agreed scope.

sections.heading: Independent providers and professional services
paragraphs: Some arrangements involve independent transport operators, accommodation providers, couriers, contractors or other specialists. We will explain the provider’s role and relevant terms before you authorise a booking. Provider availability and official decisions remain outside KTC’s control, while KTC remains responsible for its own agreed coordination duties.

Coordination, site updates and administrative support do not replace advice, certification or statutory duties reserved for a qualified lawyer, architect, engineer, immigration adviser or other regulated professional. Where specialist work is required, the professional’s appointment and responsibilities must be agreed separately.

sections.heading: Travel documents and unexpected disruption
paragraphs: Unless expressly included in an agreed brief, you remain responsible for travel documents, entry requirements, insurance and checking information relevant to your journey. KTC does not guarantee a visa, entry permission, official approval or the outcome of an application.

Weather, traffic, flight changes, closures, provider cancellations and other events may affect timings or availability. We will communicate material changes we become aware of and discuss practical alternatives. Any revised costs or refund arrangements remain subject to your agreement and applicable law.

sections.heading: Using the website and its content
paragraphs: Use this website lawfully. Do not attempt unauthorised access, disrupt its operation, submit fraudulent requests or misuse its content or contact details. The KTC name, branding, text and images remain subject to their respective owners’ rights; third-party font licences are retained with the site files.

Images are brand illustrations and are not evidence of actual KTC staff, vehicles, properties, clients or venues. Website information may be updated, so please confirm the details relevant to your request directly with us.

sections.heading: Privacy and external links
paragraphs: Our Privacy Policy explains how enquiries and personal information are handled. WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, email and other linked services operate separately and apply their own terms and privacy policies. A social-media link does not make the platform responsible for a KTC booking.

sections.heading: Responsibility and your legal rights
paragraphs: Each party is responsible for meeting its agreed obligations. Responsibility for a particular problem depends on the circumstances, the confirmed service arrangements and applicable law. These terms do not exclude liability for fraud, remove responsibility that cannot lawfully be excluded, or limit mandatory consumer or data protection rights.

sections.heading: Questions, complaints and governing law
paragraphs: If something is unclear or an arrangement falls short, contact info.kenyatravelconcierge@gmail.com or +254 717 762323 with the relevant booking details so we can work towards a resolution.

These terms are governed by the laws of Kenya. If a dispute cannot be resolved directly, either party may seek an appropriate legal remedy before a competent court, subject to any mandatory rights or jurisdiction rules that apply. Nothing here prevents a complaint to a competent regulator.

sections.heading: Updates to these terms
paragraphs: The date above identifies this version. Updated website terms apply going forward; they do not change an already confirmed service agreement unless the parties agree or the law requires it. Keep a copy of your quotation and confirmation for the terms that apply to your booking.
